heroes.name: Infernus
heroes.description: Infernus has many ways to deal damage over time, burning foes before swooping in for the kill. Due to Infernus' blazing speed, his enemies won't be able to escape the flames.
heroes.ar: يحرق الخصم مع الوقت ويكمل عليه بسرعة حركته. مناسب إذا تحب ضغط مستمر وتطارد اللي يهرب.
heroes.editorialSource: Infernus has many ways to deal damage over time, burning foes before swooping in for the kill. Due to Infernus' blazing speed, his enemies won't be able to escape the flames.

heroes.name: Seven
heroes.description: Seven thrives in a skirmish waiting for the time to strike. Then he rolls into the fight like a storm and batters his enemies with a cascade of lightning.
heroes.ar: ضرر كهرباء يصيب أكثر من هدف. يقدر يسيطر على منطقة كاملة إذا اختار وقت ومكان الألتمت صح.
heroes.editorialSource: Seven thrives in a skirmish waiting for the time to strike. Then he rolls into the fight like a storm and batters his enemies with a cascade of lightning.

heroes.name: Vindicta
heroes.description: Vindicta has the mobility to engage at her leisure, picking at her prey and bleeding them out slowly. Injured enemies at any distance should fear being picked off when she is on the map.
heroes.ar: سنايبر من بعيد، تطير عشان تختار زاوية وتخلص على الخصم المصاب. انتبه للقتال القريب.
heroes.editorialSource: Vindicta has the mobility to engage at her leisure, picking at her prey and bleeding them out slowly. Injured enemies at any distance should fear being picked off when she is on the map.

heroes.name: Lady Geist
heroes.description: Expending health to achieve devastating effects is the source of Lady Geist's power. When running low, she can drain the life out of her rivals.
heroes.ar: تدفع من صحتها عشان تضرب بقوة، وتسحب صحة أو تبدلها وقت الخطر. تحتاج توازن بين الهجوم والمحافظة على صحتك.
heroes.editorialSource: Expending health to achieve devastating effects is the source of Lady Geist's power. When running low, she can drain the life out of her rivals.

heroes.name: Abrams
heroes.description: Abrams has the bulk and sustain to lead from the front, often running into the middle of his foes and watching them scatter. If his enemies waste their fire on him, his backline teammates can lay out damage with impunity.
heroes.ar: مقاتل قريب يعيش على العلاج والميلي. يدخل بالكتف ويحب يحشر خصمه عند جدار.
heroes.editorialSource: Abrams has the bulk and sustain to lead from the front, often running into the middle of his foes and watching them scatter. If his enemies waste their fire on him, his backline teammates can lay out damage with impunity.

heroes.name: Wraith
heroes.description: Excelling at one-on-one combat, Wraith isolates targets, eliminating them with ruthless efficiency. Then teleporting away before anyone can retaliate.
heroes.ar: رصاص سريع وأوراق وقدرة انتقال. ترفع الخصم عشان تفتح لك فرصة تركز عليه.
heroes.editorialSource: Excelling at one-on-one combat, Wraith isolates targets, eliminating them with ruthless efficiency. Then teleporting away before anyone can retaliate.

heroes.name: McGinnis
heroes.description: Precise placement is everything for McGinnis, whether she's creating a killzone or splitting the enemy team. She can help keep her team running making them hard to dislodge when entrenched.
heroes.ar: تبني أبراج وتعالج فريقها وتقفل الطريق بجدار. قوية إذا جهزت مكان القتال.
heroes.editorialSource: Precise placement is everything for McGinnis, whether she's creating a killzone or splitting the enemy team. She can help keep her team running making them hard to dislodge when entrenched.

heroes.name: Paradox
heroes.description: Manipulating time lets Paradox outpace an enemy in one on one combat. She thrives by subjecting her enemies to timely swaps into a waiting pulse grenade, her wall, or into the middle of her teammates.
heroes.ar: تتحكم بتوقيت المواجهة وتبدل مكانها مع خصم. تحتاج تصويب وتنسيق مع الفريق.
heroes.editorialSource: Manipulating time lets Paradox outpace an enemy in one on one combat. She thrives by subjecting her enemies to timely swaps into a waiting pulse grenade, her wall, or into the middle of her teammates.

heroes.name: Dynamo
heroes.description: Dynamo keeps himself and his allies healthy while waiting for his moment. Few things can warp a team fight more than a well-coordinated use of Singularity.
heroes.ar: يدعم الفريق بالعلاج والانتقال، ويجمع الأعداء بألتمت قوي إذا أخذ زاوية مناسبة.
heroes.editorialSource: Dynamo keeps himself and his allies healthy while waiting for his moment. Few things can warp a team fight more than a well-coordinated use of Singularity.

heroes.name: Kelvin
heroes.description: Timely heals and splitting a teamfight properly is the difference between an easy victory or a ruinous defeat. Gliding around slowing enemies gives Kelvin's team the maneuvering advantage to make this happen.
heroes.ar: يعالج ويبطّئ ويبني مسار جليد. القبة تقدر تقلب مواجهة لك أو تحبس فريقك إذا استخدمتها بوقت غلط.
heroes.editorialSource: Timely heals and splitting a teamfight properly is the difference between an easy victory or a ruinous defeat. Gliding around slowing enemies gives Kelvin's team the maneuvering advantage to make this happen.

heroes.name: Haze
heroes.description: When Haze fixates on a target she can hold her own in a firefight. She prefers to create one sided exchanges, avoiding damage then picking off unsuspecting targets up close.
heroes.ar: تتحرك بالتخفي وتنوّم هدفها، وضرر رصاصها يزيد مع الاستمرار على نفس الخصم.
heroes.editorialSource: When Haze fixates on a target she can hold her own in a firefight. She prefers to create one sided exchanges, avoiding damage then picking off unsuspecting targets up close.

heroes.name: Holliday
heroes.description: Holliday depends on her skills as a crack shot, shooting things she's bounced into the air. With good aim she can lay out heavy damage. Her movement skills let her isolate her enemies or beat a hasty retreat.
heroes.ar: تلعب بالبراميل ومنصات القفز والهيدشوت، وتسحب هدف بالحبل عشان تفتح مواجهة.
heroes.editorialSource: Holliday depends on her skills as a crack shot, shooting things she's bounced into the air. With good aim she can lay out heavy damage. Her movement skills let her isolate her enemies or beat a hasty retreat.

heroes.name: Bebop
heroes.description: Bebop can string together his abilities in many different ways. Disrupting enemy positions, saving an ally or dealing bursts of damage. When the situation doesn't require subtlety his giant laser still solves many problems.
heroes.ar: يسحب الخصم بخطاف ويلصق قنبلة. يقدر ينقذ حليف بالسحب أو يفتح كيل على عدو.
heroes.editorialSource: Bebop can string together his abilities in many different ways. Disrupting enemy positions, saving an ally or dealing bursts of damage. When the situation doesn't require subtlety his giant laser still solves many problems.

heroes.name: Calico
heroes.description: Calico uses the shadows to her advantage, weaving in and out of combat to hunt down her enemies one by one.
heroes.ar: تدخل بسرعة وتضرب من قريب ثم ترجع للظلال. تستفيد من توقيت الدخول والخروج.
heroes.editorialSource: Calico uses the shadows to her advantage, weaving in and out of combat to hunt down her enemies one by one.

heroes.name: Grey Talon
heroes.description: A cunning predator, Grey Talon uses a combination of deadly accuracy, traps, and clever positioning to bring down the toughest of opponents.
heroes.ar: يضغط من بعيد بالطلقات المشحونة ويستخدم الفخاخ والطيران لفتح زاوية آمنة.
heroes.editorialSource: A cunning predator, Grey Talon uses a combination of deadly accuracy, traps, and clever positioning to bring down the toughest of opponents.

heroes.name: Mo & Krill
heroes.description: By burrowing through the ground, Mo and Krill can get the drop on almost anyone; and once they get in close the results can be devastating.
heroes.ar: يدخل من تحت الأرض ويعطّل الخصم من قريب. الألتمت يمسك هدف لفريقك.
heroes.editorialSource: By burrowing through the ground, Mo and Krill can get the drop on almost anyone; and once they get in close the results can be devastating.

heroes.name: Shiv
heroes.description: Shiv has zero interest in playing fair, which is why he relies on hit and run tactics to weaken enemies before he dives in for the kill.
heroes.ar: ينزّف الأعداء ويتعامل مع الضرر المؤجل، وينفذ الخصم إذا نزلت صحته تحت الحد.
heroes.editorialSource: Shiv has zero interest in playing fair, which is why he relies on hit and run tactics to weaken enemies before he dives in for the kill.

heroes.name: Ivy
heroes.description: Ivy has disruptive combat tricks that slow and stun enemies. She's most effective when linking up with an ally, empowering her and her ally's guns as well as sharing heals.
heroes.ar: تدعم حليف بالربط والعلاج، وتعطّل الأعداء بالشوك والتحجر وتتحرك بالفريق جوًا.
heroes.editorialSource: Ivy has disruptive combat tricks that slow and stun enemies. She's most effective when linking up with an ally, empowering her and her ally's guns as well as sharing heals.

heroes.name: Warden
heroes.description: Warden leads from the front, jumping into the fray and hindering his opponents' ability to fight effectively. But what Warden considers brave, others consider reckless, and if he's not careful he can easily find himself in over his head.
heroes.ar: يطارد ويضيّق خيارات الهروب. إذا الخصم ما خرج من منطقة اللعنة ينمسك، والألتمت يعالجه من الضرر.
heroes.editorialSource: Warden leads from the front, jumping into the fray and hindering his opponents' ability to fight effectively. But what Warden considers brave, others consider reckless, and if he's not careful he can easily find himself in over his head.

heroes.name: Yamato
heroes.description: Yamato uses precise strikes to decimate her rivals. However, such damaging attacks often will leave her exposed, so she needs to make every shot count.
heroes.ar: مقاتلة قريب تدخل بالسيف وتتعالج، وتستغل التحول لتمديد القتال.
heroes.editorialSource: Yamato uses precise strikes to decimate her rivals. However, such damaging attacks often will leave her exposed, so she needs to make every shot count.

heroes.name: Lash
heroes.description: Lash gives his enemies little room to breathe, either by flying in from long distances to initiate combat with unsuspecting enemies, or pursuing said enemies when they try to run.
heroes.ar: قوة من الارتفاع والحركة. يدخل من فوق ويجمع الأعداء ويرميهم بمكان يخدم فريقه.
heroes.editorialSource: Lash gives his enemies little room to breathe, either by flying in from long distances to initiate combat with unsuspecting enemies, or pursuing said enemies when they try to run.

heroes.name: Viscous
heroes.description: Viscous vexes his opponents through clever evasion and strategic uses of healing, enabling him to withstand the most brutal of enemy attacks.
heroes.ar: يتحكم بالمكان باللزج والقبضات، وينقذ نفسه أو حليف بالمكعب ويتحول لكرة للمواجهة.
heroes.editorialSource: Viscous vexes his opponents through clever evasion and strategic uses of healing, enabling him to withstand the most brutal of enemy attacks.

heroes.name: Pocket
heroes.description: With a powerful shotgun and a thin frame, Pocket relies on their ability to briefly escape into a mystic suitcase and teleport via a flying cloak in order to survive close encounters.
heroes.ar: يضر مجموعة ويعيد تموضعه بالعباءة والشنطة. يحتاج يدخل ويطلع بتوقيت مضبوط.
heroes.editorialSource: With a powerful shotgun and a thin frame, Pocket relies on their ability to briefly escape into a mystic suitcase and teleport via a flying cloak in order to survive close encounters.

heroes.name: Mirage
heroes.description: Mirage can envelop himself in a violent tornado to catch up to enemies and lift them up. His scarabs help him sustain against multiple enemies, and he's always ready to help an ally or punish an enemy anywhere.
heroes.ar: يضغط بالخنافس والعلامات، ويتنقل بالخريطة لدعم فريقه إذا ما انقطع انتقاله.
heroes.editorialSource: Mirage can envelop himself in a violent tornado to catch up to enemies and lift them up. His scarabs help him sustain against multiple enemies, and he's always ready to help an ally or punish an enemy anywhere.

heroes.name: Vyper
heroes.description: With a powerful weapon (and deadly venom to match), Vyper can slither into the back of teams and assassinate high-priority targets in a storm of bullets.
heroes.ar: يركز على السم والسلايد وتعطيل الحركة، ويستفيد من الخصم اللي نقصت صحته.
heroes.editorialSource: With a powerful weapon (and deadly venom to match), Vyper can slither into the back of teams and assassinate high-priority targets in a storm of bullets.

heroes.name: Sinclair
heroes.description: With the help of their unwilling assistant, The Magnificent Sinclair can confuse enemies with curving hexes and rapid bolts.
heroes.ar: يلعب بالمساعد وتغيير المكان، ويقدر ينسخ ألتمت عدو عشان يصنع فرصة جديدة.
heroes.editorialSource: With the help of their unwilling assistant, The Magnificent Sinclair can confuse enemies with curving hexes and rapid bolts.

heroes.name: Mina
heroes.ar: تضغط بضرر السبيرت والعضّات وتتفادى الاستهداف بالانتقال، ثم تفتح على أكثر من خصم بالخفافيش.

heroes.name: Drifter
heroes.ar: يطارد الهدف النازف ويظهر خلفه، ويعزل الأعداء بالظلام عشان يضغط عليهم.

heroes.name: Venator
heroes.ar: يعتمد على القنابل والفخ والشوتقن، ويجهز القوس لإنهاء الخصم بصحة قليلة.

heroes.name: Victor
heroes.ar: يستفيد من تلقي الضرر ويحول ألمه لضرر حوله. يحتاج يوازن استنزاف صحته مع تجددها.

heroes.name: Paige
heroes.ar: تتحكم بالمناطق بالسحر والتنين، وتحمي الحليف بدرع وتدعم الفريق بموجة الفرسان.

heroes.name: The Doorman
heroes.ar: يربط الأماكن بالأبواب ويسحب بالعربة ويرسل الخصم للفندق. يتميز بتغيير مكان وتوقيت القتال.

heroes.name: Billy
heroes.ar: مقاتل ميلي يرفع الأعداء ويربطهم فيه، ويرجع ذخيرة مع ضربات الميلي.

heroes.name: Graves
heroes.ar: يستدعي وحدات تهاجم معه ويقفل ممر بالأيدي، وسلاحه يسرق من قوة الخصم.

heroes.name: Apollo
heroes.ar: مقاتل سيف يعتمد على التوقيت والصد والاندفاعات. ضبط نافذة الضربة يعطيه أفضل ضرر.

heroes.name: Deadman Danny
heroes.ar: يطير ويستخدم الحرارة والانفجارات، ويقدر يأخذ خصم معه للأعلى ثم يسقط فيه.

heroes.name: Rem
heroes.ar: يدعم الحلفاء بالعلاج والمساعدين، ويرافق حليف ويعطّل الأعداء بالنوم.

heroes.name: Silver
heroes.ar: يمزج الرصاص وتعطيل الحركة مع تحول يغير سلاحه وقدراته. الضرر يجمع له تعطش الدم.

heroes.name: Celeste
heroes.ar: تضغط بالضوء والسبيرت، وتحمي نفسها بدرع وتستفيد من تكرار إصابة اللاعبين.

heroes.name: Rat King
heroes.ar: يجمع ضرر القنابل والفئران مع درع وراية تدعم الفريق القريب.

heroes.name: Solomon
heroes.ar: يحرك قطع الشطرنج للتحكم بالمكان، ويحمي الحلفاء ويمسك الأعداء بخطوط الحركة.

heroes.name: Violet
heroes.ar: تتحكم بالحبر: توجّه طلقاتها، ترسم حواجز ومسارات، وتجمع رسومات الخصوم عشان تكسب إحصائيات دائمة.

heroes.name: Baba
heroes.ar: تسرق سبيرت الخصم، تتحرك بمقعدها السحري، وتختار تأثير الشاي. والألتمت تجمع الأعداء تحت هجوم الحمام.

items.name: Extended Magazine
items.ar: يزيد عدد الطلقات في مخزنك ويعطيك زيادة في ضرر السلاح.

items.name: Monster Rounds
items.ar: يزيد ضرر سلاحك على الكريبات والوحوش، ويقلل ضرر رصاصهم عليك. يعطيك تجدد صحة خارج القتال.

items.name: Cultist Sacrifice
items.description: Target an enemy NPC and consume it for 170% Bonus Souls and grants a powerful long lasting buff.

desc.en: Target an enemy NPC and consume it for 170% Bonus Souls and grants a powerful long lasting buff.

items.ar: فعّله على كريب أو وحش عدو عشان تستهلكه وتأخذ سولز إضافية وبف قوي يستمر معك فترة طويلة.
items.editorialSource: Target an enemy NPC and consume it for 170% Bonus Souls and grants a powerful long lasting buff.

items.name: Tesla Bullets
items.description: Your bullets have a chance to shock your target. The shock will jump to a nearby enemy.

desc.en: Your bullets have a chance to shock your target. The shock will jump to a nearby enemy.

items.ar: طلقاتك عندها فرصة تكهرب الهدف، والكهرباء تنتقل لعدو قريب منه.
items.editorialSource: Your bullets have a chance to shock your target. The shock will jump to a nearby enemy.

items.name: Capacitor
items.description: Launch a projectile that deals damage , applies a strong slow that recovers over time, prevents Stamina usage and Silences their movement-based items and abilities .

desc.en: Launch a projectile that deals damage , applies a strong slow that recovers over time, prevents Stamina usage and Silences their movement-based items and abilities .

items.ar: تطلق مقذوف يضر الخصم ويبطّئه بقوة، والتبطيء يخف مع الوقت. يمنعه من استخدام الستامينا ويعطّل أيتمات وقدرات الحركة عنده.
items.editorialSource: Launch a projectile that deals damage , applies a strong slow that recovers over time, prevents Stamina usage and Silences their movement-based items and abilities .

items.name: Hollow Point
items.description: When you are above 65% health , deal additional Weapon Damage and your bullets reduce enemy Bullet Resist .

desc.en: When you are above 65% health , deal additional Weapon Damage and your bullets reduce enemy Bullet Resist .

items.ar: إذا صحتك فوق 65%، يزيد ضرر سلاحك وطلقاتك تقلل مقاومة الخصم للرصاص.
items.editorialSource: When you are above 65% health , deal additional Weapon Damage and your bullets reduce enemy Bullet Resist .

items.name: Opening Rounds
items.description: Your attacks have additional Weapon Damage against enemies above 50% health .

desc.en: Your attacks have additional Weapon Damage against enemies above 50% health .

items.ar: سلاحك يضرب أقوى على الأعداء اللي صحتهم فوق 50%.
items.editorialSource: Your attacks have additional Weapon Damage against enemies above 50% health .

items.name: High-Velocity Rounds
items.ar: يزيد سرعة وصول طلقاتك ويزيد ضرر السلاح.

items.name: Melee Lifesteal
items.description: Your next Melee attack heals you . This heal is 30% effective vs non-heroes. Cooldown is 1.5x as long for Light Melee hits.

desc.en: Your next Melee attack heals you . This heal is 30% effective vs non-heroes. Cooldown is 1.5x as long for Light Melee hits.

items.ar: ضربة الميلي الجاية تعالجك. العلاج على الكريبات والوحوش يكون 30% من قيمته. وقت الانتظار أطول مع الميلي الخفيف.
items.editorialSource: Your next Melee attack heals you . This heal is 30% effective vs non-heroes. Cooldown is 1.5x as long for Light Melee hits.

items.name: Rebuttal
items.description: On a successful Parry against an enemy Hero, Heal yourself for the damage parried and returns that damage to the target, and temporarily gain increased damage.

desc.en: On a successful Parry against an enemy Hero, Heal yourself for the damage parried and returns that damage to the target, and temporarily gain increased damage.

items.ar: إذا سويت باري ناجح ضد لاعب، تتعالج بقيمة الضرر اللي صديته وترجّعه عليه، ويزيد ضررك مؤقتًا.
items.editorialSource: On a successful Parry against an enemy Hero, Heal yourself for the damage parried and returns that damage to the target, and temporarily gain increased damage.

items.name: Counterspell
items.description: Your next parry protects you from the damage and effects of enemy abilities and items . On a successful spell parry heal and gain move speed and Spirit .

desc.en: Your next parry protects you from the damage and effects of enemy abilities and items . On a successful spell parry heal and gain move speed and Spirit .

items.ar: الباري الجاي يحميك من ضرر وتأثير قدرات وأيتمات الخصم. إذا نجح، تتعالج وتأخذ سرعة حركة وقوة سبيرت مؤقتة.
items.editorialSource: Your next parry protects you from the damage and effects of enemy abilities and items . On a successful spell parry heal and gain move speed and Spirit .

items.name: Weighted Shots
items.description: Your bullets build up a Movement Slow on enemies.

desc.en: Your bullets build up a Movement Slow on enemies.

items.ar: إصابات الرصاص تتراكم على الخصم لين تفعّل تبطيء الحركة.
items.editorialSource: Your bullets build up a Movement Slow on enemies.

items.name: Close Quarters
items.description: Deal additional Weapon Damage when in close range to your target.

desc.en: Deal additional Weapon Damage when in close range to your target.

items.ar: يزيد ضرر السلاح إذا كنت قريب من الخصم.
items.editorialSource: Deal additional Weapon Damage when in close range to your target.

items.name: Long Range
items.description: Deal additional Weapon Damage when beyond a minimum distance from your target.

desc.en: Deal additional Weapon Damage when beyond a minimum distance from your target.

items.ar: يزيد ضرر السلاح إذا كنت أبعد من المسافة المطلوبة عن الخصم.
items.editorialSource: Deal additional Weapon Damage when beyond a minimum distance from your target.

items.name: Slowing Bullets
items.description: Your bullets build up a Movement Slow on enemies.

desc.en: Your bullets build up a Movement Slow on enemies.

items.ar: إصابات الرصاص تتراكم على الخصم لين تفعّل تبطيء الحركة.
items.editorialSource: Your bullets build up a Movement Slow on enemies.

items.name: Inhibitor
items.description: Your bullets build up to reduce the target's outgoing damage and apply healing reduction .

desc.en: Your bullets build up to reduce the target's outgoing damage and apply healing reduction .

items.ar: إصابات رصاصك تتراكم على الخصم، وبعدها تقلل الضرر اللي يسببه وتقلل العلاج اللي يستقبله.
items.editorialSource: Your bullets build up to reduce the target's outgoing damage and apply healing reduction .

items.name: Spirit Shredder
items.description: Your bullets apply a debuff that reduces the Spirit Resist of the target and grants you and your allies Spirit Lifesteal against them.

desc.en: Your bullets apply a debuff that reduces the Spirit Resist of the target and grants you and your allies Spirit Lifesteal against them.

items.ar: طلقاتك تقلل مقاومة الخصم للسبيرت. أنت وفريقك تسترجعون صحة من ضرر السبيرت اللي تضربونه فيه.
items.editorialSource: Your bullets apply a debuff that reduces the Spirit Resist of the target and grants you and your allies Spirit Lifesteal against them.

items.name: Heroic Aura
items.description: Provides Bullet Resist to nearby friendly units.

desc.en: Provides Bullet Resist to nearby friendly units.

active.en: Provides move speed and fire rate to you and nearby allies. Minions get double value.

items.ar: يعطي الوحدات الصديقة القريبة مقاومة رصاص. عند التفعيل، يزيد سرعة حركتك وإطلاقك أنت وحلفاءك القريبين؛ التأثير مضاعف على الكريبات.
items.editorialSource: Provides Bullet Resist to nearby friendly units.

items.name: Silence Wave
items.description: Launch an expanding projectile which Silences enemies for a short duration and deals impact damage. Silence does not interrupt channeling abilities.

desc.en: Launch an expanding projectile which Silences enemies for a short duration and deals impact damage. Silence does not interrupt channeling abilities.

patches.title: Fairfax Industries Employee Spotlight
patches.text: Today, Fairfax Industries is proud to introduce their most valuable salesman: Deadman Danny. Wielding a rocket launcher and flying high above the streets of New York (courtesy of the Chimera Mk1 - the latest and greatest in self-adhered aviation technology), Danny rains his Strix Salvo missiles down upon foes, marking them for future attacks. Jettison Fuel is a handy trick that both expels heat from the Chimera System, while also dousing nearby enemies in the warm embrace of a fiery inferno. Yet his most impressive tactic has always been his ability to Close the Deal , wowing prospective customers with an explosive hands-on demonstration of all that Fairfax has to offer. - "At Fairfax Industries we say "All's Fair", but that's not true! Because with the Fairfax Chimera Mark 1, you have the advantage." Take flight with Deadman Danny, available in-game now! With only two hero releases remaining, keep your votes coming to help determine who will be joining us on Friday October 16th at 2pm PDT.

patches.title: Make Your Move.
patches.text: Solomon remains calm and collected when facing a new challenger, so when the Patrons come calling, he approaches the city as if it's one giant chessboard. With Setup Bishop he advances, planting his loyal damage dealers ahead of him and sliding them across the streets with ease. Kingside Knight comes into play when it's time for defense, granting protection to allies and making tactical retreats when needed. Rook Battery charges forward with great force, stalling enemies in their tracks. And with his final move, Develop Queen , he locks down his enemies in an ultimate checkmate. - "There's a lot you can learn from losing to a master." Solomon is available in-game now ( just in time for National Chess Day)! We're halfway through our latest set of heroes, keep your votes coming to help determine who will be joining us next Tuesday at 2pm PDT. Have a great weekend!

patches.title: Mind the Birds!
patches.text: It was a close contest, but today we find New York's notorious pigeon lady leaving her favorite perch in Central Park and joining the fight on the city streets. Tourists in the park might not think much of ol' Baba sitting on her bench - sipping tea and talking to her birds - but the locals have always suspected that something more brews below the surface. In the heat of battle, Baba throws out her Threadsap , a chaotic spool of yarn that steals the very spirit of her enemies, granting her greater power. While her legs might not be what they used to, her trusty bench comes to life with a creak of metal, allowing her to run, jump, and kick with impressive vigor. Parkgoers know it's best to stay on Baba's good side, as at tea time you might find yourself splashed with one of Baba's Brews (some of them much sweeter than others), and when tea time is over - The Birds come out to play... "They think they know magic? Oh I'll show 'em some magic." Baba and her pigeons are available now! We'll see you back here on Friday at 2pm PDT to introduce our next hero. Additionally, the end date for our first Ranked season has been pushed back to Thursday November 5th, 2026 at 2pm PDT , with the next season starting immediately after.

patches.title: City Never Sleeps
patches.text: The Cursed Apple is ever changing, and these streets are nothing like you remember. A massive visual update to the map and neutrals, six new heroes, HUD updates, numerous quality-of-life additions, accessibility options, and more. Check out everything that's new at: https://www.playdeadlock.com/cityneversleeps We also wanted to take this opportunity to talk about where we are with the development of the game and what to look forward to in the future. Our team has been incredibly happy and surprised with how passionate and supportive the community has been the past couple of years; every day someone shares something cool they've seen from the community with the rest of the team, and we are thankful for the constant support and useful feedback, despite the game being unfinished. We think building a multiplayer game is very hard and risky, and the best way to minimize that risk to make sure that we are able to have it in players' hands from an early state to help us shape it and tell us what is fun and what isn't. So, we wanted to give you all more insight into what we've been focusing on internally, as part of developing this game with your help and guidance. After the Old Gods New Blood update, we felt that there was still a good amount of work we wanted to do on the core game itself before we moved onto more polish phases of the game development (like updating older hero artwork). Unlike previous updates where our efforts were more singularly focused on the key parts of that update, this year we've been working on several different things in parallel. A good number of those are things you can see in today's update. Some others are things we've been working on in the last few months alongside this update. This even includes things like progression and hero/hideout customizations, as we feel those are features we want to be able to adjust and significantly change based on feedback before the game is fully released. There are also other things we've been working on recently that are more speculative (as in we aren't 100% sure if they will be released or not based on how playtesting goes, though results so far have been promising) like large item redesigns/additions and alternate game modes that expand the scope of the game. Then there are other things like Midboss (both the model and the layout to a degree), Guardians and Walkers, which we do consider important but just haven't gotten to yet and will be focusing on for upcoming updates. On the other hand, things like hero remodels were in our heads as something we'd get to later, towards the end of early development, after other core aspects of the game were more fleshed out. That doesn't mean we don't think they are important by any means, just that they are more of a known quantity to us that don't necessarily need to be done earlier than other things. That being said, we will likely be gradually working on them in the near future for inclusion in upcoming updates alongside other work. We hope you will like this update. Thank you all for your continued support so far during development, and don't forget to Vote!

patches.title: Minor Update - 09-16-2026
patches.text: \[ General ] - Unstable Rift comeback resist max values now scale over the course of the game. Previously the max values were 35%. Now it is 10% + 1% per minute (around ~20% for the first one), with an upper limit of 40% at 30 minutes. - Removed a fixed amount of extra bonus souls you would get for being behind even a very slightly amount in net worth for both hero kill bounties as well as Unstable Rift bounties (this had a larger impact on the early to mid game) - Slightly reduced comeback bounties in general (this is in addition to the above change) - A portion of the comeback souls earned by players above enemy teams average net worth is instead distributed via the tick gold system that is given to the lowest 2 players (70% of the extra comeback value goes to them) - Guardian bounty increased by 10% - Walker bounty increased by 5% - Share for objectives bounty to nearby heroes reduced from 30% to 25% (the remaining gets split between all 6 players) - Respawn Time at 20 minutes increased from 35s to 38s (does not affect the max values later on, just a little higher earlier) - Using parry now pauses reloading - Parrying while doing a regular dash will now cancel the dash (and momentum) and parry on the spot - Getting stunned now pauses your reload rather than restarting it - Breakables in the underground tunnels initial spawn time increased from 3m to 5m - Breakables in the underground tunnels respawn rate increased from 3m to 5m - All move slow values reduced by ~20% globally - All ground dash slows reduced by ~10% globally - Slows now also affect air drag by 35% of the slow value (convar citadel_enable_slows_affect_air_drag to toggle the slow drag behavior on and off) - Dashes and light melee's no longer pause your gun's cycle time (this is a general change that affects high-cycle time weapons the most like Silver or Abrams) \[ Items ] -
